name: Moonlit Farewell to the Autumn Swallows
description:
A massive lantern crafted by the people of Liyue to celebrate the Moonchase Festival. Its centerpiece is a full moon suspended high above a mountain valley, with swallows circling around it.
Originally, the lantern featured only the full moon. Later, its designer happened to hear about the experiences of Wind Reader. Moved by the tale of his unfulfilled promise to Silverwing, the designer added a number of swallows around the moon as decoration.
To certain antiquarians in Dihua Marsh, climbing to a high place to admire the moon, drink wine, and compose poetry in autumn is what it means to "chase the moon." But for one particular person, only "seeing the autumn swallows off" truly counts as chasing the moon.
And yet, the swallows return, as from yesterday... The swallows that come back year after year — are they still the same as those of years past?
